name: WildFin Cedar Plank King Salmon with Yukon Mashed Potatoes
brandOrRestaurant: WildFin American Grill (Mountain View Village · Riverton, UT)
whyItWorks: Wild salmon gently roasted on a natural cedar wood plank with sea salt and light glaze. High in marine omega-3s and paired with skinless, smooth Yukon Gold mashed potatoes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for salmon prepared simply with light olive oil and salt, skipping any spicy rubs or rich butter sauces. Pair with peeled mashed potatoes.
